g.text: log.trace("{}: created new gauge suite with maxEntries = {}.",suiteName,maxEntries)
log.warn("{}: Attempted to increment {}, but the GaugeSuite was closed.",suiteName,key.toString())
log.debug("{}: Attempted to increment {}, but there are already {} entries.",suiteName,key.toString(),maxEntries)
log.trace("{}: Removing the metric {}, which has a value of 0.",suiteName,keyToRemove.toString())
log.warn("{}: Attempted to decrement {}, but the gauge suite was closed.",suiteName,key.toString())
log.debug("{}: Attempted to decrement {}, but no such metric was registered.",suiteName,key.toString())
log.trace("{}: Removed a reference to {}. {} reference(s) remaining.",suiteName,key.toString(),cur)
log.trace("{}: gauge suite is already closed.",suiteName)
